subject.title: chore(scripts): remove resolved investigation tools and orphans

question: Should `scripts/recover-orphaned-processes.sh` be treated as an unsupported one-off tool that can be removed, or retained/replaced as an operator recovery diagnostic?
rationale: Repository-local reference removal cannot establish whether this executable has an external operational contract or is used by documented support and recovery workflows.

options.title: Confirm retirement and remove it
options.body: Approve deletion after confirming the script has no supported operator or runbook contract and after resolving the failed checks.

options.title: Retain or replace the recovery path
options.body: Keep the script or migrate its supported diagnostic behavior to the current owner surface before removing the legacy entrypoint.

recommendation.title: Confirm retirement and remove it
recommendation.body: Approve deletion after confirming the script has no supported operator or runbook contract and after resolving the failed checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They assembled the cleanup and are the only evidenced contributor connected to the proposed script retirement; ownership provenance remains incomplete.
